title: Limit theory for Lipschitz-localized statistics in random geometric models
summary: We study sums of locally dependent scores associated with general marked (i.e., labeled) Euclidean point processes. We introduce geometric mixing conditions on the underlying point process and a Lipschitz-"localization" condition on the scores, which jointly ensure a central limit theorem for the sums of the scores as well as expectation and variance asymptotics. Our localization condition is formulated using the bounded Lipschitz metric, providing a distributional criterion.
